stories.script: In business. French equipment maker Schneider Electric is buying factory software firm P T C. Regulators still have to approve the deal.
stories.screen: a small glowing factory building with a single gear floating beside it, simple text-free symbol

stories.script: In security. Hackers posing as A I firm an-thropic's staff sent malware to A I policy experts. Researchers tie the hackers to China's government.
stories.screen: a small glowing envelope with a fishing hook hanging above it, simple text-free symbol

stories.script: In manufacturing. Chip giant T S M C is reported to plan another price rise next year. Demand for its newest chips is said to outrun supply.
stories.screen: a small glowing computer chip with a plain upward arrow beside it, simple text-free symbol

stories.script: In robotics. Germany is paying for tens of thousands of drones, built in Ukraine. Each hunts down Russian attack drones; the exact number is not yet given.
stories.screen: a small glowing four-rotor drone with a simple shield shape beneath it, text-free symbol

stories.script: In new models. N-vidia-backed start-up Reflection is said to be readying an open A I model. Open means anyone can run it; nothing has shipped yet.
stories.screen: a small glowing open box with a simple brain shape rising out of it, text-free symbol

stories.script: In health. A Stanford team had thirty seven thousand A I agents read old drug trials. The agents found a clue to safer drugs; no lab has tested it.
stories.screen: a small glowing pill capsule under a simple magnifying glass, text-free symbol

stories.script: In daily life. McDonald's reportedly uses A I to set menu prices in America. It calls the tool optional; some store owners say they feel pushed.
stories.screen: a small glowing hamburger with a blank price tag hanging from it, simple text-free and number-free symbol

fun.script: And something lighter. Munchy's Pizza, a Florida family shop, promised never to use A I. The promise drew tens of thousands of people online.
fun.screen: a small glowing pizza slice with a simple heart floating above it, text-free symbol

teaser.script: Also in the full report. I B M says its quantum chip beat a supercomputer in one test. A I gun turrets are said to guard Kyiv from drones.
teaser.screen: a small glowing stack of papers with a bookmark ribbon on top, simple text-free symbol

bp.script: And for the bigger picture: hopes for A I prop up tech shares. Yet U S borrowing costs are the highest since two thousand two. Watch if they stay this high; the A I rally depends on that.
bp.screen: a small glowing stack of coins with a simple rising zigzag line above it, text-free and number-free symbol
